mainImage.alt: Rows of suitcases lined up outside a synagogue in Larnaca, Cyprus, belonging to Israelis who fled the October 2023 war
mainImage.caption: Suitcases of fleeing Israelis lined up outside the Chabad synagogue in Larnaca, Cyprus, October 2023, as thousands sought refuge after the outbreak of war.
